purpose: Test whether the assurance-by-investment-cost negative selection route occupies a non-isolated parameter region, survives variation in inbreeding depression, and propagates under annual and perennial life histories.

surface_nonisolated_if: at least 50% of low-activity-region cells have negative total gradient
each inbreeding-depression level has at least 25% negative cells in that region
predeclared_decision_rule.central_contiguous_if: for assurance=0.5 and cost=0.5, every depression level has at least two adjacent activity levels <=0.1 with negative gradient
predeclared_decision_rule.life_history_propagation_if: at activity=0.05, deterministic and finite-ABM mean investment changes are negative in all three depression levels for annual and both perennial treatments, with terminal occupancy >0 in the finite ABM
predeclared_decision_rule.drop_rule: if route_A_robust is false, remove Route A as a headline causal result and retain it only as a model-conditional possibility/SI result

claim_boundary: Parameter ranges are robustness envelopes, not natural estimates.
The negative gradient remains a consequence of the declared reproductive-return and cost functions; robustness can establish a non-isolated mechanism region, not empirical truth.
Adult survival 0.75 represents an expected multi-year adult life within this model, not a calibrated perennial species.
The lifetime-budget-matched treatment rescales annual ovule and pollen budgets by 0.25; it is a sensitivity analysis, not an exact life-history equivalence.
